prohibition: Never serve this file or put its contents, test expectations, fixture source, or fault plan into a model prompt or agent context.

evidenceContract.identity: Each observation must bind to the exact run, frozen plan, actual target URL, action, and subsequent capture. A screenshot existing is not proof that it was read or that an interaction occurred.
evidenceContract.clicks: Require the source URL and named link in the executed click trace, then the actual destination/status and post-action observation. Direct URL navigation or browser Back cannot replace a required click.
evidenceContract.screenshot: Read the captured bytes and verify that the stated heading/text is visible on the linked page. DOM text alone does not prove pixel visibility. Masked or unavailable regions are unknown, not product defects.
evidenceContract.report: Known defects need an original failed check, a current supported review, and an applicable independently read citation in the saved report. Positive and negative checks retain separate evidence coverage. No retry-until-green.
evidenceContract.limits: This file defines an external oracle, not an implemented Syna acceptance driver. HTTP fixture tests do not prove real clicks, screenshots, model behavior, tenant authorization, or a completed QA pipeline.
